summary: This is a routine Form 6-K filing by Sprott Physical Silver Trust, a closed-end fund, reporting its interim management report of fund performance and unaudited interim financial statements for the period ended March 31, 2026. The filing covers investment objective, risks, and results of operations, including unit issuances and redemptions under an at-the-market offering program. There are no special situation events such as acquisitions, divestitures, going-private transactions, or strategic reviews. The filing is a standard periodic report of a foreign private issuer with no transformative corporate action.
